notes.title: Update to Address Game Crashing Issues - June 12 (Thu)
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team.



We have confirmed that the game could crash under the following specific conditions.

An update to mitigate these issues has now been applied.

A potential crash that could occur when using NVIDIA graphics cards

A potential crash related to the on-screen guide when certain conditions are met

A potential crash that could occur during the tutorial

Please restart the game to apply the update.



If you encounter any other issues while playing, please report them through the #|game-feedback channel on our official Discord.



Thank you.

notes.title: How to Check and Install a Supported Graphics Driver Version
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Vindictus: Defying Fate team.



As mentioned in our previous announcement and FAQ, we’ve identified crash issues related to certain graphics driver versions. Since the start of the Alpha Test, we’ve received a notable number of crash reports related to this issue.



In particular, crashes have been observed specifically with NVIDIA Graphics Driver version 576. We kindly ask you to download and use version 572 or earlier, as previously advised.



Please refer to the instructions below to check your current graphics driver version and download a supported version.



1. Check Your NVIDIA Graphics Driver Version

1) Open the NVIDIA App from the icon in your Windows taskbar.

(You can also check the version through NVIDIA Control Panel or GeForce Experience.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/2565e3e555d403091f687dfe7e57a56ef95cccc5.png"]



2) Check your driver version:

- You can find this under System > My Rig in the NVIDIA App.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/5c3104dd7414d2f19d6c9171f4592b358cba313e.png"]





2. Download NVIDIA Graphics Driver Version 572 or Earlier

If you are currently using NVIDIA Graphics Driver version 576, the game may crash during launch. A driver version lower than 576 is required.

We recommend installing version 572 or earlier by following the steps below.



1) Uninstall the current driver (version 576.XX) from your PC.



2) Visit the official NVIDIA website and enter your graphics card details to search for available drivers. \[Go to NVIDIA Driver Search](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/)



3) Download driver version lower than 572

We recommend that you download 572.XX versions such as below from the results.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902898/254b29332cda88172f03e5a740a6765e8f4dd7c6.png"]

If you encounter any further bugs or technical problems, please report them through the #｜game-feedback channel on our official Discord server.

Thank you.

notes.title: (UPDATE) Known Issues
notes.notes:
Dear Mercenaries,  

Below are Known Issues during the pre-alpha test. 


■ 3/14(Thu.) Known Issues  

 Cannot start the game while using certain AMD Radeon series graphics cards.
[strike][quote=]Please follow the initial workaround steps below for this issue:
[olist]
 Right Click Vindictus: Defying Fate Playtest on Steam Launcher
 Click [Properties]
 Go to [General] and type -dx11 in [LAUNCH OPTIONS]
[/olist]
Please note that frame rate drops or crashes may occur depending on the type of graphics card after following the workaround above.[/strike]


 Crash upon launching with a pop-up saying 'Please install the latest driver version or switch to a different rendering API.'
[quote=]Please update your Graphics Driver to the latest version to resolve this issue.


 An intermittent issue where the game freezes during the network connection. (NEW)
[quote=]You may play the game normally by restarting the game from the Steam Library from 3/13 8:52 PM PDT.


 An issue where [Camera Control: Vertical] and [Camera Control: Horizontal] - [Inverted] is not being reflected, when applied from [Title > Settings]. (NEW)
[quote=]Settings will be reflected normally if it's applied during the gameplay.

Our developers are currently working to identify and resolve the cause of the issues, and we will make every effort to resolve them. 

Please understand the issues may not be addressed during the pre-alpha test period.  


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.
